body:
weight: heavy
tier: 0
charter: C5

specs/factory-step3-v1/SPEC.md row TB5 (ruling Q3 of specs/factory-step2-followups-v1/RULINGS.md). main's `.adlc/config.json` has no `fleet` block, so fleet refuses every real ticket at preflight. The block itself is desk-written (`.adlc/**` is outside every ticket's scope, row TB3): the step-3 loop writes it as a desk commit, and this ticket makes CI and the node run exactly its commands.

Closes the pre-spec simulation gaps node:G10, merge:G19 (ids are `<segment>:<id>` rows of specs/factory-step3-v1/records/sim/<segment>.md, re-checked in specs/factory-step3-v1/records/TB0.md).

Deliverables:
- main's `.adlc/config.json` carries one repo-wide `fleet` block (gate.test, gate.build, desk-written allowedCommands, prosecuteFailOn, timeoutMinutes; adapter, model and key stay CLI-only), every key checked against fleet 1.12.0's config reader (cited file:line).
- `factory/bin/build-test.sh` reads the gate commands from the base config and runs exactly those; gates.yml's build-test job calls it instead of a hard-coded `make test`.
- `make lint`'s shellcheck download fallback is replaced or pinned so `gate.build` runs under the build profile's no-network rule; if a node needs shellcheck installed, join.sh's probe requires it.

Acceptance criteria:
1. main's config parses for fleet: a schema check of every key against fleet 1.12.0's reader. Verify: `bash tests/test_policy.sh`.
2. CI and the node run the same command list, read from the base config. Verify: `bash tests/test_build_test.sh`.
3. The join probe requires shellcheck when gate.build needs it. Verify: `bash tests/test_join.sh`.
4. The toy ticket passes fleet's preflight on a scratch copy of main's config. Verify: `make live` (tests/live/test_smoke_live.sh).
5. Every new or changed script is shellcheck -S warning clean and every workflow passes actionlint. Verify: `make lint`.
6. The whole offline suite passes, including the simulation. Verify: `make test` and `make sim`.

New paths (created by this ticket, so they match nothing yet): `factory/bin/build-test.sh`, `tests/test_build_test.sh`.

Out of scope: any write to GitHub (no push, PR, label, ruleset or secret; I1); editing anything under factory/policy/ (I15: a change there is a desk note in the spec's HANDOFF); editing other tickets.
title: Make CI's build-test run main's fleet gate commands from the base config, with a lint that runs offline
